data.exact_reserve_text: The surplus / (deficits) following the reassessment of claims outstanding held at the end of the previous year are set out below. The FRS 103 transitional provision has been applied, which allows the Syndicate not to disclose information about claims development that occurred earlier than 5 years before the end of the first financial year in which FRS 103 is applied.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reported ultimate claims incurred of GBP 18.2m gross and GBP 16.3m net to Covid-19; estimates remained materially unchanged through 2021; GBP 8.7m of the net loss is attributable to direct impacts in the Global Re and Marine divisions with remaining exposure due to secondary economic impacts from government action and lockdown restrictions.

named_events.loss_description: Reported ultimate claims incurred of GBP 18.2m gross and GBP 16.3m net to Covid-19; estimates remained materially unchanged through 2021; GBP 8.7m of the net loss is attributable to direct impacts in our Global Re and Marine divisions, remaining exposure due to secondary economic impact.

data.standardized_narrative: For the year the Syndicate recorded a prior-year gross surplus on claims outstanding of GBP 9.649m (a release of approximately 1.37% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 704.764m). The surplus arose from favourable claims development across several classes (notably Marine, Energy and Property) partially offset by adverse movement on third party liability and reinsurance acceptance. COVID-19 related claims of GBP 18.2m gross (GBP 16.3m net) were reported but estimates remained materially unchanged through 2021.

Favourable loss experience resulting in prior year reserve releases during 2021.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) prior-year column (2020) on page 23. Prior year development taken from the 'surplus/(deficits) following the reassessment of claims outstanding held at the end of the previous year' table on page 40 (gross amounts). COVID-19 numbers are explicitly stated in the Strategic Report (page 6). Segmental premium mix taken verbatim from the 'Analysis of underwriting result' table on page 39. A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes (page 41) but the full triangle was not fully transcribed here; small negative gross premium for 'Energy - non marine' is presented in the statutory segmental table as (9) thousand, included as a small negative amount. All monetary amounts are reported in the native currency (GBP).
